listing.name: Customizable Phase Glow
listing.summary: Customizable Phase Glow (CPG) is a small mod that lets you change and customize the phase glow effects on phase ships. It adds an in-game UI in the refit screen so you can pick from multiple glow presets and tweak visual parameters per-ship Download using trios: https://trilink.wispborne.com/open.html?mod={%22url%22:%22https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DeCEll-1/CustomizablePhaseGlow/refs/heads/master/CPG.version%22,%22id%22:%22CustomizablePhaseGlow%22,%22version%22:%221.0.0%22}

description:
Customizable Phase Glow

Download by clicking the banner

Or by using trios:

Customizable Phase Glow (CPG) is a small mod that lets you change and customize the phase glow effects on phase ships. It adds an in-game UI in the refit screen so you can pick from multiple glow presets and tweak visual parameters per-ship

Current possible modifications, all of which are customizable:

Radial

Spoiler[close]Flux Dependent

Spoiler[close]Speed Dependent

Spoiler[close]Hull Dependent

Spoiler[close]Single Color

Spoiler[close]
